taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key anatomical terms from the Front & Medial side of the thigh.

words.clue: Four-headed anterior thigh muscle extending the knee
Longest muscle in the human body, forming lateral boundary of femoral triangle
Thin medial adductor muscle forming part of pes anserinus
First adductor muscle supplied by both femoral and obturator nerves
Group of medial thigh muscles innervated by the obturator nerve
Major nerve, artery, and vein traversing the femoral triangle
Nerve entering through obturator canal to supply adductors
Muscle originating from lumbar vertebrae as primary hip flexor
Opening in adductor magnus allowing femoral vessels to pass into popliteal fossa
Ligament forming the superior boundary of the femoral triangle
Bi-articular head of quadriceps acting on both hip and knee
